description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseMetadataDatatype' which extends 'BaseOpenmrsDatatype' and is used as a superclass for custom datatypes related to OpenMRS metadata. It provides a method to generate a text summary of metadata instances.

classes.name: BaseMetadataDatatype
classes.description: An abstract Java class that serves as a superclass for custom datatypes for OpenMRS metadata, parameterized with type T that extends OpenmrsMetadata.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Overrides a method to generate a summary of the typed value, returning a Summary object with the name of the metadata and a boolean flag.
